description_en: Queries the total number and proportions of HTTP status codes returned from an accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData查询加速域名HTTP返回码的总数和占比数据
name: DescribeDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple accelerated domain names and separate them with commas (,).

You can specify up to 100 accelerated domain names in each request
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

一次最多可以传100个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISP names
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html获得，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions. If you do not specify a region, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh: 地域英文名。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html获得，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en:
The time interval between the data entries returned. Unit: seconds.

Depending on the maximum time range per query, the value is 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), or 3600 (1 hour). For more information, see the "Time granularity" section in Usage notes
DataInterval.description_zh:
每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数固定返回60（1分钟）、300（5分钟）或3600（1小时），具体请参见使用说明中返回数据时间粒度

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried
